snippet.title: Farm Manager World - Official PlayStation 5 PS5 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Farm Manager World is now available on PlayStation 5 & 5 Pro: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016275

Transform a humble plot of land into a thriving global farming empire. Master optimizing crops, livestock, and supply chains in distant regions. Navigate shifting markets and wild weather as you balance profit and efficiency. Watch your small farm blossom into an agricultural powerhouse recognized worldwide.
